text:
sophia_sales: Kicking off MediAssist POC — need alignment on success criteria, golden prompts, scoring, and security asks. Can we lock scope by EOD tomorrow? TL;DR: 4-week POC, 3 prioritized use cases (triage summarization, billing Q&A, discharge note autofill).

jamie_presales: Sounds good. Proposed acceptance gates: latency p50 < 300ms, accuracy >= 85% on golden set, hallucination rate < 2% on safety set. I'll assemble the golden prompts. What do we want for regression thresholds?

alex_engineering: For infra, we'll provision a Dedicated starter pool (1xA10x8) for the POC. Need expected qps and median sequence length to finalize batching config. Recommendation: enable prefix KV caching for triage and autofill to cut costs. We'll test int8 quantization if quality holds.

eli_product: Add a structured-output gate for discharge notes — outputs must validate against provided JSON schema. Scoring: schema_pass (binary) + content_f1. Also add an evaluation for hallucination where medical facts are asserted; we should sample manual labels.

nina_security: Heads up — MediAssist may process PHI. We need a signed BAA for any production or private deployment. Hosted tier is out unless they redact upstream. Security checklist: encryption at rest + in flight, KMS key ownership, audit logs retention, and VPC peering for Dedicated/Private. I can start the questionnaire but need specifics on model access and data retention.

sophia_sales: They confirmed some PHI could flow through discharge notes if not redacted. For now plan Private or Dedicated with BAA. @jamie_presales please update the scoping doc to reflect BAA requirement and the security checklist.

jamie_presales: On it — will update the doc and create the golden seed. Proposed golden set sizing: 150 labelled prompts (70/30 label split across reviewers) distributed as 60 triage, 60 discharge, 30 billing. Train/Validation/Regression split: 70/20/10. Regression gates: any drop >3% in case-level accuracy OR >1% absolute increase in hallucination rate triggers immediate rollback + investigation.

jamie_presales: Sample scoring rubric I'm going to use:
```
# Scoring rubric (per example)
- correctness_score = micro_f1 between model output and reference (0..1)
- schema_pass = 1 if output validates JSON schema else 0
- hallucination_flag = manual label (0 or 1) for asserted unsupported facts
- latency_score = max(0, 1 - p95_latency_ms/1000)

overall_score = 0.5*correctness_score + 0.2*schema_pass + 0.2*(1 - hallucination_rate) + 0.1*latency_score
Pass criteria: overall_score >= 0.85 AND hallucination_rate < 0.02
```

deploy-bot: New ticket created: POC-3426 "MediAssist POC - Eval harness + Security" (<https://issues.redwood.net/POC-3426>)

eli_product: Timeline proposal: week1 - onboarding + infra + data ingest; week2 - labelling golden set and initial eval; week3 - tuning, quantization experiments, and regression run; week4 - acceptance run + exec demo + handoff. Can we compress any steps?

alex_engineering: We can overlap labelling and initial eval in week2 if Jamie provides a seed set early. Also can run parallel quantization experiments during week3. Need sample load profile by tomorrow to lock autoscale/burst policies.

sophia_sales: Pricing note from customer: they want a 3-month pilot with hard cap on monthly spend. I'll propose a Dedicated starter package + managed SRE add-on and a short-term discounted rate, then move to committed Reserved capacity if we go into production. @eli_product, can you draft the pricing bullet so Sales can include in the LOI?

eli_product: Drafting now — will aim for a headline: Dedicated starter $3k/day + SRE support $1k/week, overage at usage rate X per token. Need legal to sign off on BAA terms too.

nina_security: I'll start the security questionnaire and flag the BAA. Please add required retention periods and deletion policy in the scoping doc. Also confirm who holds the KMS keys (customer-managed preferred).

jamie_presales: I will own the eval harness + golden dataset. Deliverables: initial 40-seed prompts by Tue, full 150 prompts labelled by end of week2, scoring scripts + CI checks for regression gates, and a short Jupyter demo to show evaluation flow.

sophia_sales: Great — can everyone react with :thumbsup: if aligned?

alex_engineering: :thumbsup:
eli_product: :thumbsup:
nina_security: :thumbsup: (starting questionnaire)
jamie_presales: :thumbsup: will post link to harness repo when ready

jamie_presales: link to scoping doc + checklist: <https://docs.redwood.com/poc/mediassist-scoping> — adding BAA and security section now.

sophia_sales: Thanks team — target to lock scope + pricing by EOD tomorrow. If anything blocks, drop it here and I'll escalate.

jamie_presales: Last note on regression: we'll tile the regression suite into smoke (fast, ~50 examples) and full (150 examples). Smoke runs on every deploy; full runs nightly during the POC.

sophia_sales: Perfect.
